# pdf-tool

> Agent-friendly CLI for inspecting, creating, and editing PDF files.

Repository: https://github.com/evrenverse/pdf-tool
Package: https://pypi.org/project/pdf-tool/
License: MIT
Language: Python

## Start here

- README.md: installation, guarantees, dependencies, and examples
- AGENTS.md: safe agent setup and contribution rules
- skills/pdf-tool/SKILL.md: concise runtime workflow
- skills/pdf-tool/references/cli.md: command examples
- SECURITY.md: trust model and secret handling
- CONTRIBUTING.md: development contract
- docs/agent-contract.md: versioned machine interface and exit behavior
- docs/architecture.md: component and trust-boundary overview
- evals/README.md: reproducible locate-edit-verify evaluation

## CLI

Install with:

    uv tool install pdf-tool

Discover exact syntax with:

    pdf-tool --help
    pdf-tool <command> --help
    pdf-tool capabilities --json
    pdf-tool doctor --json
    pdf-tool schema
